title: Two Lessons Learned from the SGILE project: Efficient Building and Evaluation of TTS Voices
abstract: In line with the "Speaking Together" theme for Interspeech 2026, our Show & Tell showcases two contributions arising from recent work on the "Speech Generation for Indigenous Language Education" (SGILE) project. Both contributions facilitate building TTS voices for under-resourced languages: 1) the open-source EveryVoice TTS Toolkit can build high-quality voices using constrained amounts of audio data typical for under-resourced languages; 2) we have methodically evaluated speech evaluation techniques with the aim of maximising insights gained while minimising listener effort, especially important when few listeners are available. Our demo takes the form of a web app which combines both these aspects in a single interactive interface: users can experience first-hand a selection of EveryVoice TTS voices through a listening test design that has been little used in the speech synthesis field so far.
relevance_note: Show & Tell on the EveryVoice toolkit for low-resource TTS voices and an efficient TTS evaluation approach from the SGILE project; TTS tooling and evaluation.
